name: Jackintosh Multidrive Emulation
description: Floppy and hard disk images, the clock and the PRAM for the Jackintosh ROMs, which turn an Atari ST/STE/MegaST/MegaSTE into a Macintosh Plus. Works only with the Jackintosh ROMs in the TOS sockets (a SidecarTridge TOS Emulator, or EPROMs): put your Mac disk images in /jackintosh on the microSD card and choose them in the Jackintosh menu. Under TOS it only offers to return to Booster or the GEM desktop. Learn more
